title: Following the child's trace saddle
description: Accepted moving trace-saddle centers versus retained feedback, with the translated center path in scaled steering and log-temperature coordinates.
alt_text: Left: selected-pair trace at corrected saddles decreases from positive at zero retained feedback to negative at 0.7 percent; a star near 0.645 percent marks the residual-qualified crossing estimate. Right: the saddle moves toward greater steering and lower log-temperature. Lines connect 18 accepted samples without extrapolation.

provenance.copy: byte-identical copy of audited external PDF

visual_review.scope: Visual QA of PNGs; PDF hash bound to the same plotting run. Original immutable receipt retains its pending field; this separate review supersedes that review status only.

uncertainty_semantics: Observed numerical sensitivity only, not an interval certificate or parameter error bar.
limits: The partial parent attempt contributes only its accepted centers; its rejected trust step remains preserved.
The root is residual-qualified, not exactly zero.
A trace reconnection is not exact superstability or a demonstrated reconnection of strongest-contraction ridges.
